title: Complete guide-copying pass
statement: Let $W$ be a finite Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $a\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a finite schedule-alphabet word. For any base configuration on $x$, integers $b,u$, and budget and unary tapes, starting in copy-left phase with input head at position $1$, guide head at cell $0$, and blank guide tape, after exactly $2|x|+4$ steps the machine is in budget-start phase with input head at position $|x|+1$, guide head at cell $0$, and guide tape equal to the partial guide with $|x|+1$ copied cells; the base data, budget tape and head, unary tape and head are unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: schedule input x and base configuration
replaced:
From a setup configuration in the copy-left phase with input head at position $1$,
guide head at cell $0$, and entirely blank guide tape, exactly $2|x| + 4$ steps ---
covering both virtual boundary cells and the return to the origin --- reach the
budget-start phase with input head parked at position $|x|+1$, guide head at cell $0$,
and guide tape the partial guide with $|x|+1$ copied cells; the budget and unary tapes
and heads are unchanged, and the native input stays parked from then on.
